info.title: Budget Splitter API
info.description: A service for recording joint expenses in Telegram

get.summary: Returns the current balance summary for the specified group.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: ID of the group to get balances for.

get.summary: Calculates and returns suggested transfers to settle debts within the group.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: ID of the group to suggest transfers for.

parameters.name: useNpAlgorithm
parameters.description:
If true, use the NP-complete optimization algorithm for minimal transactions;
otherwise use the greedy algorithm.

get.summary: Retrieves the history of operations (expenses and payments) for the group.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: ID of the group to retrieve history for.

get.summary: Retrieves all confirmed expenses in the group, optionally filtered by a specific user.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Optional user ID to filter expenses by payer.

post.summary: Creates a new expense in the group.

get.summary: Retrieves details for a specific expense.

delete.summary: Deletes an expense from the group.

parameters.name: expenseId
parameters.description: ID of the expense to delete.

parameters.name: expenseId
parameters.description: ID of the expense to update.

put.summary: Updates an existing expense’s total amount.

parameters.name: expenseId
parameters.description: ID of the expense to update.

get.summary: Retrieves all participants and their shares for an expense.

post.summary: Adds a participant share to the expense and adjusts the payer’s share accordingly.

requestBody.description: Share details of the new participant.

put.summary: Updates the share amount for an existing participant in an expense.

requestBody.description: Updated share details for the participant.

delete.summary: Removes a participant from an expense and reallocates their share to the payer.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: ID of the participant to remove.

get.summary: Retrieves all groups the specified user belongs to.
Retrieves all groups the specified chat belongs to.
Retrieves detailed information about a specific group.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: ID of the group to retrieve.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: ID of the group to update.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: ID of the group to delete.

post.summary: Adds a user to the group.

requestBody.description: Details of the user to add.

delete.summary: Removes a user from the group.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: ID of the user to remove.

get.summary: Retrieves all payments (expense-based and direct) in the group.

post.summary: Records a payment against a specific expense.
Records a direct payment (transfer) between two users in the group.

put.summary: Updates an existing payment’s amount or recipient.

parameters.name: paymentId
parameters.description: ID of the payment to delete.

get.summary: Retrieves an overview of all users in the system.
Retrieves detailed information for a specific user.
Retrieves detailed information for a specific user by nickname or userTelegramId.
